title: User Persona
description: Per-user, isolated persona. Never pooled or generalized across users.

onboarding_profile.description: Cold-start snapshot. Written once at onboarding, read by inference to seed inferred_patterns.

mc_answers.description: Multiple-choice onboarding answers (daily rhythm, known triggers, etc). Keyed by question id.

voice_transcript_analysis.description: Summary derived from voice-recorded open answers at onboarding.

interaction_log.description: Passive signal. Append-only. One entry per intent lifecycle event.

inferred_patterns.description: The layer that turns raw logs into something the reminder engine can act on. Written by Persona Agent, read by Reminder Agent.

confidence.description: Per-field confidence/coverage metrics, to make overfitting-to-one-user risk visible rather than silent.

active_clarifications.description: Active signal: periodic micro-questions asked to fill gaps passive data can't explain.
